rows.name: maxArgumentBytes
rows.qualification: Original argument grammar remains unchanged.

rows.name: maxPathBytes
rows.qualification: Not a cumulative path-length sum.

rows.name: maxReadBytes
rows.qualification: No per-pack/object refund; provider allocation is not an owned-resident claim.

rows.name: maxInflatedBytes
rows.dimension: cumulative codec output plus delta reconstructed bytes
rows.qualification: Include discarded/duplicate output; work mask requires source proof, not injected counters.

rows.name: maxObjectBytes
rows.dimension: per direct body, delta program and reconstructed body independently
rows.qualification: Not their cumulative sum and not permission to allocate all independently without resident checks.

rows.name: maxWorkingFileBytes
rows.qualification: Preserved M1A query boundary; no broader working-file reader.

rows.name: maxIndexBytes
rows.dimension: per working index or pack idx admission
rows.qualification: D2 proposes same numerical size ceiling for inert sidecar lstat, not a body-read grant.

rows.name: maxMetadataBytes
rows.dimension: per admitted metadata region/file/header as existing callers require
rows.qualification: Preserved per-value admission, not a new global metadata counter.

rows.name: maxResidentBytes
rows.qualification: Only successful ownership release refunds occupancy; includes charged text/tables; not exact RSS.

rows.name: maxEntries
rows.qualification: Physical pack occurrences must be charged; specify repeated listing/table charging sites.

rows.name: maxObjects
rows.dimension: invocation deduplicated loose plus packed OID census
rows.qualification: Global name dedup cannot bypass verification of any physical location.

rows.name: maxCommits
rows.dimension: shared cumulative parsed-commit count plus existing command/traversal bounds
rows.qualification: Cached commits are not reparsed as new owners; preserve original query limits.

rows.name: maxDepth
rows.qualification: Not cumulative across unrelated trees; no recursion-reset loophole.

rows.name: maxRefDepth
rows.dimension: per symbolic-ref or tag resolution chain
rows.qualification: Distinct from delta representation depth.

rows.name: maxDeltaDepth
rows.qualification: Direct0; cached base retains intrinsic depth; cannot use cache-miss count.

rows.name: maxSteps
rows.qualification: Each stated scan/hash/CRC/copy/compare/replay charged before work; checkpoint interleaving still requires source proof.

rows.name: maxDiffCells
rows.qualification: Original diff algorithm/grammar unchanged; no per-file reset.

rows.name: maxLines
rows.qualification: No per-file reset or package-source waiver.

rows.name: maxOutputBytes
rows.qualification: Not a promise any object/query can reach this ceiling after earlier masks.

rows.name: maxDiagnosticBytes
rows.dimension: per diagnostic publication under existing single diagnostic path
rows.qualification: Separate from stdout; no blanket diagnostic/status relaxation.

rows.name: maxChunkBytes
rows.dimension: per yielded VFS/codec chunk and output partition
rows.qualification: Does not alone bound total output, queues, native work or allocation.

rows.name: maxChunks
rows.dimension: cumulative yielded VFS source rows in existing Session
rows.qualification: Author must declare any new codec-output counting extension; do not silently change inherited scope.

rows.name: maxPacks
rows.qualification: No per-pack reset or ignored ninth unselected pair under eager admission.

rows.name: maxPackBytes
rows.dimension: per pack stat and exact read extent
rows.qualification: At-C success masked by shared read/work; +1 admission refusal is separate.

coexistenceEquation: resident = pack + retainedRawIdx + decodedMetadata + cacheOwners + currentProgram + currentResult + wrapperBuffers + otherInvocationOwners; count a cached base once, retain duplicate body until verified dedup

arithmetic.expression: charged copy work >= admitted codec-produced plus delta-reconstructed bytes

refunds: Resident only after owned lifetime proof; never read/inflate/work/depth refunds
